coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Orange County Property Appraiser maintains the official county assessment parcel map. This is local assessor parcel coverage, not a title-registration extract.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Six distinct Orange County assessment parcel polygons passed bounded public adapter qualification around the unchanged Orlando WUP settlement locator. Thirteen 0.001-degree cells contain the same large point-containing parcel; its complete footprint discovers six distinct parcels. All six native PARCEL strings passed fresh independent reads, forced one-feature pages and matching full geometry hashes. Exact-point containment, explicit absence and one-parcel proposal binding passed. Independent root EPSG:26917 full-polygon GEOS audit found no invalidity, duplicate geometry, overlap above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Assessment parcel references are not legal title; bounded evidence does not establish citywide completeness, survey accuracy or currentness.
